name: Towazuki no Miko
source:
Main character belongs to one of three prominent families of the village. According to ancient tradition on his 20th birthday he must choose himself a bride from one of remaining two prominent families. When protagonist's parents go on a trip, he starts to live together with both girls...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公出身村中三大名门之一。
按照古老传统，在20岁生日当天，他必须从另外两家中挑选一位新娘。
父母外出旅行后，他便开始与两名女孩同住……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
